description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Request the configurations with the intention to sync some or all of the configurations created or modified since the lastModified timestamp.
At most, 5000 configurations will be returned from this endpoint in one request.
Continue making requests with the same lastModified to get the remaining configurations. The API remembers itself where you left off.

query.description: (Required) change since date for the configurations to sync
the ID of the last configuration in the previous response. It is the responsibility of the API client to extract this value and use it for the next call.
Number of records to return. If API client omits this parameter, the 20 is the default value.

This application offers an API for managing assignments and tasks.

>
